methodologyNote: Measured via social media referrals in tracked traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, YouTube led social media in India at 38.91% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Facebook ranked second at 35.84%, followed by Instagram at 15.61%.

faqs.question: Which item leads social media in India?
faqs.answer: YouTube leads at 38.91% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/social-media-stats/india.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.
